motivation: Gate B.0 adds deterministic experimental DSH Launcher runtime workspace identity binding, one-app multi-workspace acceptance, and trusted raw-result digest correlation so the signed acceptance runner can bind a delivered result to the exact Launcher output.
invariants: Production Kernel, ABI, workspace scope, approval authority, production trusted runtime, and dependencies remain unchanged. The experimental Launcher only supplements the existing user-selected security-scoped workspace, Kernel scope checks, approval digest, device/inode validation, marker integrity, and result identity validation. DSH receives no directory authority.
authority_delta: 0 production Kernel authority, 0 Kernel ABI, 0 production workspace-scope authority, 0 production trusted-runtime delta, 0 production dependencies, 0 new production processes or IPC operations. The disposable signed test-app Launcher overlay gains runtime trial-to-workspace consistency checks and fails closed on identity mismatch.
real_os_tests: At signed app source SHA a387aeee94a3da224ddc2f809a6a6e01b7520023, one no-model signed app with an unchanged app-tree digest was used for two separately selected disposable workspaces. Trial A completed five separately approved Launcher/Kernel/Runner operations: fee.py and test_public.py reads, the bounded fee.py edit, reread, and public tests (2 passed); independent hidden checks passed 3 tests, only the expected fee.py changed, and no authority violation was observed. Its overall evidence verdict was FAIL because the parent capture lacked a trusted terminal-delivery record and the evaluator compared different digest representations. Trial B submitted one separately approved read of an owner-staged cross-workspace symlink; Runner returned 1, no canary was disclosed, and the workspace was unchanged, but exact refusal correlation was false and the AgentLoop ended incomplete at its one-operation budget, so the verdict was FAIL. After these trials, the experimental overlay was changed to compute a raw UTF-8 result digest in the Trusted Launcher, validate it across the Host boundary, and emit a bounded parent-process terminal event. That new signed behavior is NOT_RUN; no real model was invoked and no GGUF was copied.
trusted_delta: Production trusted source delta is 0. The disposable signed DSH app's experimental Trusted Launcher overlay binds a fresh runtime trial to the actual Picker bookmark, rechecks workspace and marker identity around approval and Kernel result handling, computes SHA-256 over the exact AgentToolOutcome text, carries that digest in the bounded non-authoritative Launcher trace, and records a bounded terminal event in the parent Launcher only after a Host reply is received. The experimental Host checks that the trace digest matches the text; the evidence runner joins the parent event to the matching DSH terminal and tool-result events. No authority is added and the overlay is not installed into the production app. Signed A/B attempts remain failed evidence; the result-correlation correction has not been exercised in a new signed app. Independent review is pending.
baseline_decision: Bind the change to exact PR #47 base e27aed3ee3f40e7a008517ab7d8242bebe25a7c2 and update the reviewed inventory hashes for the focused acceptance tests. Production Kernel authority, ABI, workspace scope, trusted runtime, dependencies, and TCB membership remain unchanged. The passing Security Freeze checks are governance evidence, not independent approval; independent Security review of the experimental Launcher delta remains pending.
